headline: US oil refinery stocks surge 150% year-to-date as heavy maintenance season looms
summary: US oil refinery equities have risen approximately 150% this year amid elevated operational capacity. Analysts predict an intensive maintenance period for facilities following high throughput.
why: Oil refining capacity directly influences crack spreads, refined product inventories, and fuel prices across international energy markets.

impacts.name: US Oil Refining
impacts.why: Strong refining margins and high utilization rates drove significant equity gains.

why_moved: Sustained high capacity utilization and favorable refining economics drove investor demand for downstream energy stocks.
